subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should OpenClaw change core/provider behavior so MiniMax Token Plan media and office skill workflows are inherited by sub-agents, or should the core keep the current AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md boundary and route Token Plan office workflows through plugin/skill/ClawHub surfaces after live endpoint proof?
rationale: The source confirms the current endpoint and bootstrap behavior, but the requested fixes cross provider endpoint contracts, sub-agent context inheritance, and optional skill-bundle ownership; automation cannot safely choose that product boundary from source alone.

options.title: Preserve boundary, prove provider bug first
options.body: Keep sub-agents on AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md, require live MiniMax Token Plan proof for any endpoint change, and publish or document mmx office workflows as a skill/bundle if current plugin surfaces suffice.

options.title: Add Token Plan inheritance support
options.body: Define and implement an explicit sub-agent skill inheritance contract for Token Plan workflows, accepting the compatibility and prompt-boundary risk as product direction.

options.title: Provider-only repair
options.body: Fix only the confirmed MiniMax image/media provider route after live proof and leave office SKILL.md loading outside this issue.

recommendation.title: Preserve boundary, prove provider bug first
recommendation.body: Keep sub-agents on AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md, require live MiniMax Token Plan proof for any endpoint change, and publish or document mmx office workflows as a skill/bundle if current plugin surfaces suffice.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main routing candidate across the MiniMax resolver, bootstrap boundary, and adjacent media completion code paths.
